subunit: Homodimer. May form a complex composed of RHO, GRK1 and RCVRN in a Ca(2+)-dependent manner; RCVRN prevents the interaction between GRK1 and RHO. Interacts with GRK1. Interacts (phosphorylated form) with SAG. Interacts with GNAT1. Interacts with GNAT3. SAG and G proteins compete for a common binding site. Interacts with PRCD; the interaction promotes PRCD stability. Forms a complex with ASAP1 and ARF4. Forms a complex with ASAP1, RAB11A, Rabin8/RAB3IP, ARF4 and RAB11FIP3; the complex regulates Golgi-to-cilia rhodopsin/RHO transport in photoreceptors
